description: European electricity market: day-ahead spot prices (EUR/MWh, 15-minute or hourly) for a bidding zone such as DE-LU, FR, NL, BE, AT, PL, DK1, NO2, SE3, IT-North, with min/max/average for the day, and optionally the cross-border physical flows (GW, positive = import) between a country and each neighbour. Data from ENTSO-E/SMARD as republished by Fraunhofer ISE's Energy-Charts API; licence string returned with each answer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

flows.description: Optional 2-letter country (de, fr, nl, at, pl…) for cross-border physical flows

zone.description: Bidding zone, e.g. DE-LU, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, CZ, PL, HU, DK1, DK2, NO1-NO5, SE1-SE4, IT-North, ES, PT (default DE-LU)
